decisions.reason: As an evolved version of an already established trommel screen with clear customer acceptance, it fits the firm's core screening portfolio and is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
The full AK line was actively updated to EU Stage V in 2019, which signals ongoing investment in a core mobile shredding range rather than preparation for exit.

Mobile high-speed grinders match the firm's main customer applications and the stronger website presentation in 2019 suggests the range was still being built up, though with somewhat more uncertainty than the best-supported lines.

The CERON stationary pre-shredder line was presented as a new generation setting standards and shown in concrete applications, making it a strategically important product family that is unlikely to be dropped soon.
